Eine Frage von Demütigung und Respekt? Kämpfe um Würde in der Arbeit und ihre politischen Implikationen 




„

In Deutschland lässt sich eine steigende Thematisierung von Klassenverhältnissen in wissenschaftlichen wie auch öffentlichen Debatten erkennen. Grund hierfür sind zum 

einen die Erfolge, die rechtspopulistische Parteien, wie etwa die AfD in Deutschland oder auch der Rassemblement National in Frankreich, in den arbeitenden Klassen erzielen. Das hat zu einer Reihe von Beiträgen geführt, die der Frage nachgehen, ob rechtspopulistische Parteien „die neuen Arbeiterparteien“ sind (vgl. Jörke / Nachtwey 2017) und, falls diese Beobachtung zutrifft, was zu dieser Entwicklung geführt haben könnte (vgl. Eribon 2016, mit Blick auf Deutschland stellvertretend für viele andere die 

Aufsätze in Becker et al. 2018). Zum anderen trägt die wieder erstarkende Auseinandersetzung mit Klassenverhältnissen im Allgemeinen sowie der Arbeiterklasse im Besonderen der nicht mehr zu leugnenden Tatsache Rechnung, dass soziale, politische und ökonomische Ungleichheiten in den liberalen Demokratien stetig zunehmen und die Demokratie existenziell bedrohen (…) Der Arbeitsplatz als zentraler Aushandlungsort dieser Kämpfe um Würde ist dabei von besonderer Bedeutung (vgl. Costas 2023, Kratzer et al. 2015). Denn die kapitalistisch organisierte Lohnarbeit ist einerseits eine strukturelle Bedingung für Entwürdigungserfahrungen, gleichzeitig ist 

Arbeit aber ein zentraler moralischer Bezugspunkt, insbesondere auch für die Arbeiterklasse, um sich Würde und Respekt anzueignen und Gerechtigkeit einzufordern (vgl. Honneth 2012, Lamont 2000, Negt 2020). Im Folgenden möchte ich diese Thematik mit der Frage nach der Unterstützung politischer Parteien verknüpfen. Anhand einer Auswertung des von der FES zur Verfügung gestellten Datensatzes „Kartografie der Arbeiter:innenklasse“ gehe ich zwei Forschungsfragen nach: 1) Wer leidet unter welchen Missachtungserfahrungen in der Arbeit und kämpft folglich um Würde in der Arbeit? Ein besonderes Augenmerk gilt dabei der Frage nach Klassenzugehörigkeit sowie Klassenbewusstsein. 2) Inwieweit können diese Kämpfe um Würde in der Arbeit auch einen Erklärungsansatz für politisches Stimmverhalten liefern?…“

Jede*r dritte Beschäftigte mit Rechtsextremismus am Arbeitsplatz konfrontiert – Umfrage zeigt Handlungsbedarf für Betriebe




„Rechtsextremismus macht auch vor Werktoren, Büroräumen, Kindertagesstätten oder dem Einzelhandel nicht halt: In Deutschland hat jede*r dritte Beschäftigte rechtsextreme Einstellungen am Arbeitsplatz wahrgenommen. Das ergab eine repräsentative Civey-Umfrage im Auftrag von Gesicht Zeigen!, die erstmals eine Bestandsaufnahme zum Phänomen Rechtsextremismus in Wirtschaft und Arbeitswelt ermöglicht. Demnach ist fast jede*r zehnte Beschäftigte als Opfer rechtsextremer Einstellungen am Arbeitsplatz persönlich betroffen. „Die Zahlen zeigen, dass Unternehmen handeln müssen“, sagt Geschäftsführerin Sophia Oppermann „Zudem wünschen die Beschäftigten nicht nur eine klare Positionierung der Unternehmen, sondern auch entschiedenes Handeln.“ (…) „Unternehmen zeigen zunehmend Gesicht – das unterstützen wir“, so Sophia Oppermann. „Jetzt kommt es allerdings darauf an, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und zu handeln: demokratische Werte im Unternehmensleitbild verankern, jährliche Workshops oder Weiterbildungen anbieten und eine feste Ansprechperson im Unternehmen etablieren.“ Rechtsextreme Einstellungen am Arbeitsplatz wirken sich nach Ansicht einer deutlichen Mehrheit der Beschäftigten negativ auf das Betriebsklima aus, ein gutes Drittel sieht Schwierigkeiten bei der Fachkräfte-Gewinnung und -Sicherung. Dennoch ist jede*r fünfte Beschäftigte und jede*r dritte Entscheider*in der Meinung, dass die Verbreitung rechtsextremer Einstellungen keinerlei Auswirkungen auf Arbeitsplatz, Ruf des Unternehmens oder Fachkräfte-Sicherung habe. Hier zeigt sich laut Oppermann, dass die Gefahr durch Rechtsextremismus häufig unterschätzt wird…“

 

Pressemitteilung vom 6. Juni 2024 von gesichtzeigen.de

 

 zur 37-seitigen 

Studie

 

 

 „Unternehmen in Verantwortung! Umfrageergebnisse zu Rechtsextremismus in der Arbeitswelt – Herausforderungen und Handlungsbedarf”




Neue Analyse: Einkommen, Mitsprache, Anerkennung: Erfahrungen im Job können demokratische Einstellungen stabilisieren – oder unterminieren




„Das Erstarken rechtsextremer und anti-demokratischer Einstellungen in Deutschland steht mit Erfahrungen sozialer Desintegration in Verbindung, mit denen sich ein relevanter Teil der Bevölkerung konfrontiert sieht. Dazu zählen unter anderem Befürchtungen, den eigenen Lebensstandard nicht halten zu können, Sorgen um die Alterssicherung und um die berufliche Zukunft, die beispielsweise bei Erwerbspersonen, die zur AfD tendieren, weit überdurchschnittlich verbreitet sind. Aber auch mangelnde Mitsprache am Arbeitsplatz und das damit verbundene Gefühl, mit tiefgreifenden Veränderungen in Arbeitsleben und Gesellschaft ohne Möglichkeit zur Einflussnahme nicht Schritt halten zu können – oder der Eindruck, dass die berufliche Leistung vom Arbeitgeber nicht ausreichend anerkannt wird, sind wichtige Faktoren. Das zeigen aktuelle Studien, unter anderem des Wirtschafts- und Sozialwissenschaftlichen Instituts (WSI) der Hans-Böckler-Stiftung, über die WSI-Direktorin Prof. Dr. Bettina Kohlrausch in einer neuen Kurzanalyse einen Überblick gibt. „Es ist für Demokratien lebensbedrohlich, wenn ein wachsender Teil der Bevölkerung die Gestaltung der Gesellschaft zwar im Rahmen demokratischer Rechte mitverantwortet, die grundlegenden Werte und Regeln, die sie ausmachen, aber nicht teilt. Menschen müssen sich die Demokratie und ihre Werte zu eigen machen, damit sie funktioniert“, warnt die Soziologin. Einer der Faktoren, die zu einer Erosion demokratischer Einstellungen führen können, ist die Erfahrung von Anerkennungsverlusten bzw. Anerkennungsbedrohungen, ergeben unter anderem Untersuchungen des Soziologen Prof. Dr. Wilhelm Heitmeyer oder die Leipziger Autoritarismus-Studie. Die Forschung am WSI der letzten Jahre hat auf empirischer Basis herausgearbeitet, dass sich solche Bedrohungs- und Verlustgefühle aus geringer oder fehlender materieller, sozialer und demokratischer Teilhabe speisen. „Alle drei Dimensionen von gesellschaftlicher Teilhabe sind relevant und stehen mit anti-demokratischen Einstellungen in Zusammenhang“, betont Kohlrausch. „Unsere Befragungsdaten zeigen, dass unter Menschen, die zur Wahl der AfD tendieren, solche subjektiven Bedrohungs- und Verlusterfahrungen überdurchschnittlich verbreitet sind.“ So finden sich in den unteren Einkommensgruppen besonders viele Wähler*innen der AfD. „Oft verbinden sich Bedrohungs- und Verlustgefühle dann mit migrationskritischen bis -feindlichen Stereotypen, die insbesondere AfD-Stammwähler*innen sehr oft vertreten. Der AfD gelingt es im aktuellen politischen Diskurs erfolgreich, oben-unten Konflikte in innen-außen Konflikte umzudeuten.“ (…) „Die multiplen Krisen dieser Zeit und die großen gesellschaftlichen Veränderungen wie die Digitalisierung, die Dekarbonisierung und der demographische Wandel haben zur Folge, dass sich Verteilungskonflikte einerseits zuspitzen und anderseits zentrale gesellschaftliche Fragen neu ausgehandelt werden müssen“, erklärt die Soziologin. Ein zentraler Aushandlungsort ist laut Kohlrauschs Analyse nach wie vor der Betrieb. Faktoren wie die Tarifautonomie oder das Betriebsverfassungsgesetz bestimmten ebenso wie soziale Schutzrechte für Beschäftigte den formalen Rahmen dieses Aushandlungsprozesses – und seien daher wichtige Ressourcen auch für die politische Demokratie. (…) Positive, die Demokratie stärkende Elemente müssten sowohl eine ausreichende materielle Absicherung als auch das Erleben sozialer Anerkennung und demokratischer Beteiligungsmöglichkeiten umfassen. Hierzu gehöre zunächst, die Primärverteilungsfunktion des Arbeitsmarktes zu stärken, um Beschäftigten materiell angemessen abzusichern. Die Stärkung der Tarifbindung identifiziert die Soziologin als einen wichtigen Baustein dafür…“

 

Pressemitteilung der Hans-Böckler-Stiftung vom 12. März 2024

 

 zur 5-seitigen 

Analyse von Bettina Kohlrausch

 

 

: „Demokratie in Arbeit – Erwerbsarbeit als demokratischer Erfahrungskontext“ vom März 2024

content:
„… 

Die AfD etabliert Gerechtigkeitsvorstellungen, die auf den Vorrang von Deutschen in den Leistungssystemen abheben. Wer in die Sozialsysteme »einwandert« oder nicht als leistungsbereit und produktiv wahrgenommen wird, soll perspektivisch von allen Sozialleistungen ausgeschlossen werden. Die Partei kann dabei an produktivistische Vorstellungen von Sozialmoral anknüpfen, die auch außerhalb der AfD vertreten werden und bis in die sozialdemokratische Rhetorik der »hart Arbeitenden« reichen. (…) Die sehr hohen Wahlergebnisse unter den »Arbeiter:innen« erscheinen spektakulär und werden von der AfD als Street Credibility vereinnahmt. Der Blick auf die »Angestellten« zeigt aber, dass das Problem der Landnahme der Rechtsextremen innerhalb der Lohnabhängigen breiter zu diskutieren ist. Neben der Qualifikation (die nicht automatisch mit Einkommenshöhe, sozialer Sicherheit und Stabilität des Jobs korreliert), ist es das Geschlecht, das den Unterschied macht

…“ Daten und Interpretationen in 

2 Artikeln der AG Wahlbeobachtung

 

 in 

express – Zeitung für sozialistische Betriebs- und Gewerkschaftsarbeit

 – Ausgabe 10/2026




Siehe auch:







[„Sachsen-Anhalt ist ein Alarmsignal für die Gewerkschaften“] Solidarität muss man erfahren


„

Die AfD gewinnt weit über ihr rechtes Kernmilieu hinaus – besonders unter 

Arbeiter:innen. Wer darauf nur mit Aufklärung über ihr Programm und Bekenntnissen zur Demokratie antwortet, unterschätzt das Problem. (…) Denn die Rede davon, Arbeiter:innen würden »gegen ihre eigenen Interessen« wählen, setzt voraus, dass aus einer sozialen Lage eindeutig folgt, worin das eigene Interesse besteht. Aber so funktioniert politisches Bewusstsein nicht. (…) Klassenlage produziert kein Klassenbewusstsein. Objektive Interessen sprechen nicht für sich selbst. Sie müssen erkannt, interpretiert und organisiert werden. Genau hier setzt die AfD an. Sie spricht Teile der arbeitenden Klasse gezielt an, artikuliert deren Interessen aber nicht als gemeinsames Klasseninteresse. Sie übersetzt soziale Erfahrungen in Gruppeninteressen, die gegeneinander in Stellung gebracht werden (…) Es reicht nicht, Beschäftigten ihre »richtigen« Interessen zu erklären. Wenn Menschen mehrere, teilweise widersprüchliche Interessen haben, ist die politische Aufgabe nicht pädagogisch, sondern organisierend. Sie besteht darin, unterschiedliche Interessen so miteinander zu verbinden, dass gemeinsame Handlungsfähigkeit entstehen kann. 

Das ist der Kern von Klassenpolitik

…“

13 Adar 2026










“Destûrê nadin ku em biçin ser zeviyên xwe”




Şênî li cihekî nêzî qada projeyê li astengiya jendermeyan rast hatin û xwestin, ku sparteya hiqûqî ya karê li herêmê tê meşandin bê eşkerekirin. Serokê Komîsyona Bajar û Hawirdorê ya Baroya Amedê Ahmet Înan diyar kir ku astengî ne tenê li qada projeyê ye, her wiha li derveyî qada kar jî şênî nikarin biçin nava zeviyên xwe.




Parlamenterê Amedê yê DEM Partiyê Berdan Ozturk jî anî ziman ku ew li dijî projeyê ne, mafê jiyanê yê gundiyan ji wan tê standin û tê xwestin ku mirov ji cih û warê xwe koç bikin.




Şêniyên taxê jî diyar kirin ku ew debara xwe bi çandinî û sewalkariyê dikin û destnîşan kirin ku santral li ser tenduristî, sewalkarî û paşeroja wan gef e. Şêniyan ragihandin ku li hemberî karê şîrketê wê xak û çêrgehên xwe biparêzin û ew projeyê naxwazin.




Têkoşîna hiqûqî




Serokê Komîsyona Bajêr û Hawirdorê ya Baroya Amedê Ahmet Înan diyar kir ku li dijî destûra dayina çêrgehê, plana îmarê û rapora ÇED'ê doz vekirine û pêvajoya hiqûqî dewam dike. Înan anî ziman ku wê hemû hewldanên xwe yên hiqûqî dewam bikin û ji bo nobeda kon jî bê mezinkirin bang li saziyên demokratîk û parêzvanên jiyanê kir.




Piştî daxuyaniyê şêniyên taxê li qada projeyê dest bi nobeda kon kirin. Şêniyan diyar kirin ku ji bo parastina xak û qada xwe ya jiyanê wê berxwedana xwe dewam bikin.




*Çavkanî: MA

author: CMI Argentina
title: Apelaron el fallo que benefició a los prefectos del grupo Albatros que mataron al joven mapuche Rafael Nahuel
content:
En septiembre pasado, la Cámara Federal de Casación Penal hizo lugar a las defensas y redujo la condena de los cinco integrantes de la agrupación Albatros de Prefectura Naval Argentina que formaron parte del operativo que dio muerte a Rafael Nahuel en el marco del conflicto de Villa Mascardi, Río Negro. Frente a esa medida, los padres del joven fallecido representados por el abogado Rubén Marigo, referente de la Asamblea Permanente por los Derechos Humanos (APDH), interpusieron un recurso extraordinario.







En la presentación Marigo expone que la decisión dada a conocer el mes pasado modifica “sustancialmente las penas impuestas a los condenados, disponiéndose además su ejecución condicional y dejándose sin efecto las penas de inhabilitación especial”. Tal determinación causa a los padres de Rafael Nahuel “un gravamen federal, actual e irreparable”.




Cabe recordar que el 25 de noviembre de 2017, dos días después del violento desalojo de la comunidad, Rafael Nahuel fue a la lof lafken Winkul Mapu en Villa Mascardi para llevar ayuda, alimentos y abrigo a los jóvenes que habían logrado escapar de las balas, y fue sorprendido por una patrulla de la Prefectura que le disparó por la espalda mientras huía. Los cinco prefectos del grupo Albatros fueron condenados tras el juicio oral que culminó en noviembre de 2023. Sergio Cavia recibió 5 años de prisión e inhabilitación por homicidio agravado cometido con exceso en la legítima defensa, en tanto a Francisco Javier Pintos, Juan Ramón Obregón, Carlos Valentín Sosa y Sergio García les dieron una pena de 4 años y 6 meses de prisión como partícipes necesarios.




El abogado expone en el texto que en cambio el fallo de Cámara, que la familia apeló redujo la pena de Cavia a tres años de prisión, de Obregón, dos años y seis meses de prisión, de Pintos y Sosa a dos años y tres meses de prisión, de García a dos años de prisión; todas de penas de prisión en suspenso. De tal forma, el abogado Marigo indicó que ese fallo “modifica sustancialmente la respuesta punitiva establecida respecto de los condenados”, incluso “disponiendo su ejecución condicional”. Asimismo, remarca que quedaron “sin efecto las penas de inhabilitación especial”.




Marigo sostuvo que “la resolución recurrida produce, de este modo, una modificación sustancial de la decisión adoptada por el tribunal de juicio respecto de la respuesta penal correspondiente a los hechos por los cuales los imputados fueron condenados, afectando de manera directa los derechos e intereses de mis mandantes en su carácter de querellantes y familiares de la víctima”.




El abogado de la familia de Rafael Nahuel cuestionó la arbitrariedad del razonamiento empleado por la sentencia recurrida para apartarse de la valoración efectuada por el Tribunal Oral Federal de General Roca. A su criterio, “la participación necesaria de Pintos, Obregón, Sosa y García y la plataforma fáctica sobre la que ella fue establecida permanecían incólumes, la reducción de las penas exigía una fundamentación que demostrara concretamente la arbitrariedad de la valoración efectuada por el Tribunal Oral, y no solamente una ponderación distinta de los mismos elementos”.




En cuanto a haber dejado sin efecto la inhabilitación especial, el abogado subrayó que esa determinación “no constituía una sanción desvinculada del hecho juzgado, sino una pena directamente relacionada con la condición funcional de los condenados y con la utilización de armas reglamentarias en el marco de una actuación estatal que culminó con la muerte de Rafael Nahuel. Se trata, por ello, de una sanción que adquiere particular relevancia frente a un hecho de violencia institucional y que debía ser examinada atendiendo precisamente a la función pública en cuyo ejercicio se produjo el hecho”.




Frente a esa consideración, indica: “Sin embargo, la sentencia recurrida utiliza como fundamento para excluir la inhabilitación circunstancias tales como la ausencia de antecedentes, las buenas condiciones personales y la realización de cursos de capacitación para el servicio público, sin explicar por qué esos mismos elementos resultan suficientes para neutralizar la necesidad de impedir que los condenados continúen ejerciendo funciones vinculadas con el empleo de armas estatales”.




El letrado expresó que “si la formación recibida por los imputados es utilizada como argumento favorable para excluir la inhabilitación, la sentencia debía explicar por qué esa misma formación no reforzaba, por el contrario, la necesidad de una respuesta que contemplara la responsabilidad derivada del ejercicio de una función estatal armada”. Y agregó que “se este modo, la sentencia recurrida no demuestra de manera suficiente por qué, frente a las características del hecho, la condición funcional de los condenados y la gravedad del resultado producido, la inhabilitación especial resultaba innecesaria. La mera afirmación de que la pena es facultativa no satisface esa exigencia de fundamentación”.




“Dejar sin efecto los ocho años de inhabilitación impuestos a Cavia y los siete años impuestos a los restantes condenados, sin explicar adecuadamente por qué esa pena resulta innecesaria frente a las características concretas del hecho, implica una reducción sustancial de la respuesta punitiva que no encuentra suficiente fundamento en la sentencia recurrida”, advirtió el abogado en el recurso extraordinario. Y afirmó que “la sentencia recurrida no se limita a revisar la razonabilidad de la decisión adoptada por el Tribunal Oral, sino que sustituye su valoración mediante criterios que no aparecen suficientemente explicados y que, en algunos aspectos, reciben un tratamiento desigual frente a situaciones sustancialmente comparables. Tales defectos de fundamentación, considerados en conjunto, afectan las garantías de defensa en juicio, debido proceso e igualdad ante la ley, y determinan la arbitrariedad de la resolución recurrida en los términos de la doctrina de la Corte Suprema de Justicia de la Nación”.




Así, Marigo solicita que el alto tribunal “haga lugar a la impugnación, declarando la nulidad de la sentencia recurrida y devuelva las actuaciones al órgano competente para que dicte un nuevo pronunciamiento conforme a derecho”.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Con los cambios que impulsaba la oposición, Diputados aprobó la nueva Ley de Fortalecimiento al Sistema de Discapacidad
content:
El proyecto obtuvo media sanción con 237 votos a favor, tras forzar a La Libertad Avanza a garantizar fondos frente al ajuste de Caputo. Incompatibilidades blindadas, plazos para saldar deudas con prestadores y el rechazo de los cordobeses alineados al oficialismo.




Foto: Pablo Lecaros




En una sesión de alta intensidad y tras más de cuatro horas de discusión, la Cámara de Diputados de la Nación le dio media sanción al proyecto de Ley de Fortalecimiento del Sistema de Discapacidad. La iniciativa cosechada en el recinto arrojó un contundente resultado de 237 votos afirmativos, 9 negativos y 4 abstenciones, logrando un consenso transversal que ahora deberá ser revalidado en el Senado. Sin embargo, la amplia ventaja numérica no opacó la trastienda de una negociación donde los bloques de la oposición dialoguista y el peronismo obligaron al oficialismo a modificar el texto original para blindar partidas frente al Presupuesto 2027.




El dictamen definitivo, impulsado formalmente por La Libertad Avanza tras aceptar modificaciones de la oposición, funcionó como un dique de contención frente a los recortes planteados por la Casa Rosada.




Lo que se mantiene de la ley de emergencia es, por ejemplo, la compatibilidad entre el goce de una pensión contributiva por discapacidad (70% del haber jubilatorio mínimo) para titulares del CUD y tener un empleo formal o monotributo, siempre y cuando los ingresos no superen los dos salarios mínimos vitales y móviles.




Además se mantiene el principio de nomenclador único, se ratifica la indexación automática periódica de los aranceles de las prestaciones por el índice de movilidad jubilatoria (atado al IPC), y se garantiza la cobertura básica de protección médica del Plan Federal Incluir Salud para quienes tengan la pensión por discapacidad.




En cuanto al financiamiento, se establece que la asignación presupuestaria del Ministerio de Salud no podrá ser inferior en términos reales al ejercicio fiscal del año anterior.




Por otro lado, se crea un sistema de auditorías periódicas con cruce de datos de ANSES, ARCA, SINTyS y RENAPER bajo el principio del debido proceso inclusivo.




Y se incorporó a pedido de aliados una cláusula transitoria que exige un cronograma para el pago de las compensaciones atrasadas a prestadores, con un plazo máximo de 30 días para la reglamentación del Poder Ejecutivo.




Durante toda la jornada, los referentes de Unión por la Patria se juntaron durante horas con representantes de colectivos de discapacidad para discutir con ellos la posibilidad de confluir con el oficialismo en el dictamen de mayoría en lugar de seguir aferrándose a la prórroga de la emergencia hasta el 31 de diciembre del 2027.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "A Spark from the Cockroaches": Arundhati Roy on India's Youth Protests & Modi's Crackdown
content:
A court in India on Wednesday ordered the release of two leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party, the youth-led movement that has led historic waves of protests in India since the summer. Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das were detained amid massive protests last week after they scaled a barricade to enter a site popular for protest, unfurled the national flag and called for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Kumar oversaw the deletion of 130 million names from the voter rolls in India since June of last year. Opposition parties say those impacted are primarily Muslims and other minorities less likely to support the 

BJP

, the Hindu nationalist ruling party of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.




“You have a deep and wide — an ideologically wide — historical culture of resistance in India,” says acclaimed writer and activist Arundhati Roy. At the same time, the Modi government “has three things in its playbook: One is false-flag attacks, two is engineering communal riots, and the third is massive repression. And I don’t think we’ve seen its hand yet.”

author: CMI Argentina
title: Diputados: LLA y aliados le dieron media sanción a la nueva ley de Inviolabilidad de la Propiedad Privada
content:
El oficialismo de la Cámara baja tuvo que ceder y ratificar en el proyecto la ley de Tierras y la eliminación de un artículo del Decreto de Necesidad y Urgencia (DNU) 70/2023 de Javier Milei. Por dos tercios, queda blindado para su pase al Senado. Cuáles fueron las abstenciones claves.







Por Federico Pokorowski




La Cámara de Diputados le dio media sanción al proyecto de ley de Inviolabilidad de la Propiedad Privada, al que La Libertad Avanza (LLA) le tuvo que ceder y ratificar la ley de Tierras, sancionada durante el gobierno de Cristina Kirchner, y la eliminación del artículo 154 del Decreto de Necesidad y Urgencia (DNU) 70/2023 de Javier Milei, que sostenía la norma sancionada en 2011.




La nueva Inviolabilidad de la Propiedad Privada fue aprobada por 124 votos a favor, 119 en contra y 6 abstensiones. Estas últimas fueron claves, ya que garantizaron la media sanción del texto. Quienes no expresaron postura fueron los cordobeses de Provincias Unidas Juan Schiaretti, Alejandra Torres, Carolina Basualdo, Ignacio García Aresca y Carlos Gutiérrez, además de Álvaro González, larretista que se sienta en la bancada del PRO.




Los capítulos 38 a 40, que incluían la ratificación de la ley de Tierras, fueron votados por 239 votos a favor, cuatro en contra y seis abstenciones. Al haber más de dos tercios, no puede ser modificado por el Senado.




La ratificación de la ley de Tierras y la eliminación del artículo 154 forman parte de un operativo blindaje del oficialismo para con el mega decreto desregulador del Presidente, que oficia, como señalan voces de la oposición dura, de reforma constitucional encubierta. El DNU 70/23 estuvo cerca de ser rechazado la semana pasada, en una sesión que había sido motorizada por la oposición dura.




Para blindar la integridad del DNU 70/23, LLA sacó del freezer la ley de Inviolabilidad de la Propiedad Privada. Este texto vino del Senado tras una media sanción, que incluyó el retiro de un artículo que vaciaba la ley de Tierras.




El ataque de LLA a esta norma despertó a sectores de la sociedad por fuera del micromundo político y la media sanción se dio con una represión de las fuerzas de seguridad en las afueras del Congreso. La consecuencia política fue que se muteó al autor del texto, el ministro de Desregulación y Modernización del Estado, Federico Sturzenegger.




Santiago Santurio




Lo qué se dijo




El diputado de La Libertad Avanza Santiago Santurio defendió el proyecto de ley de Inviolabilidad de la Propiedad Privada, afirmando que “el Estado no puede caprichosamente tomar un bien que no le corresponde”.




“Es fundamental que entendamos que respetar la propiedad privada es garantizarle a cada uno que el fruto de su trabajo no se lo va a sacar ni un delincuente ni un burócrata de turno”, afirmó el miembro informante del dictamen de mayoría.




Por el rechazo,  el diputado de Union por la Patria Diego Giuliano le recordó al oficialismo que “han vuelto a la ley del peronismo”, en referencia a la ratificación de la ley de Tierras, sancionada durante el gobierno de Cristina Kirchner.




“No sé con qué cara lo van a mirar a León XIV cuando él cree en la función social de la vivienda”, les espetó el representante del Frente Renovador, que afirmó que la ley propuesta por el oficialismo es “mirada desde la Ciudad de Buenos Aires y desde la fundación Heritage”, un 

think tank

 libertariano de Estados Unidos.




A su turno, el diputado de la Coalición Cívica Maximiliano Ferraro afirmó que el oficialismo está “reculando en chancletas” al proponer “dejar sin efecto un artículo de un DNU (70/23) totalmente inconstitucional que defienden a capa y espada”.




Desde Provincias Unidas, Martín Lousteau afirmó que con el proyecto del oficialismo se “encarecen” las expropiaciones y “acorta los plazos para responder una demanda por desalojo”




Tambien pidió la derogación del DNU 366/25 a través del cual “uno puede adquirir ciudadanía por 350 mil dólares” ya que habilita a los extranjeros a comprar tierras, por fuera de los topes que establece la ley de Tierras.




Qué dice el proyecto




En las comisiones, el oficialismo aceptó insertar artículos al proyecto: uno que establece eliminar el artículo 154 del mega DNU desregulador que deroga la ley de Tierras y otro que plantea la vigencia de esta norma, sancionada en 2011.




El texto que vino del Senado establece criterios más rígidos para las expropiaciones (ley 21.499). En ese sentido, la declaración de utilidad pública será de “interpretación restrictiva y deberá identificar en forma específica y concreta el fin perseguido, y la expropiación del bien deberá ser idónea, necesaria y proporcional para alcanzarlo”. También estipula un tope de lucro cesante de un 30% del valor del daño emergente.




Además, incluye modificaciones a la ley Pierri (24.374), por que podrán acceder a pedir un titulo de propiedad quienes ocupen un inmueble de forma pacífica, ostensible y continua durante diez años.




El capitulo II, por su parte, realiza modificaciones al Código Procesal Civil y Comercial y al Código Civil y Comercial. En el artículo 679 del primero, se modifica para establecer que el desalojo de un inmuebles se sustanciará por el procedimiento el juicio sumarísimo, que es más expeditivo que el juicio sumario, que figura en la legislación actual.




También se propone la incorporación al artículo 1222 del Código Civil y Comercial en el que se establece que en caso de falta de pago, el locador tiene diez días de corrido para recibir el pago. En caso de el locatario no cumpla, el propietario “puede iniciar la acción judicial de desalojo, la que debe sustanciarse por el procedimiento más breve que prevea la ley”.




Finalmente, se establece la creación en la ley de Registro de la Propiedad Inmueble (17.801) de un Consejo Federal de Registros de la Propiedad Inmueble, que promoverá la creación de una Ventanilla Única Federal Inmobiliaria, “consistente en un portal web que permita a los ciudadanos profesionales legitimados solicitar, abonar tasas y recibir informes, certificados y copias expedidas por cualquier registro de la propiedad inmueble del país”.

author: Unknown
title: Where are the Zapatistas 30 years later?
content:
The Zapatista Army of National Liberation (EZLN – Ejército Zapatista de Liberación Nacional), which emerged in Chiapas in the first days of 1994, came to the world's attention through an armed uprising in a region of Mexico marked by widespread poverty and inequality, where Indigenous people make up a significant proportion of the population. However, it was not only the uprising that made the Zapatista experience distinctive.




In the years that followed, the movement moved away from the goal of seizing state power and developed a practice of autonomy centred on the right of Indigenous communities to govern themselves. In this direction, it established autonomous governance, education, healthcare and production structures based on local communities. Over more than thirty years, as demands for Indigenous rights and political autonomy were not sufficiently realised, the Zapatistas declared their own autonomous governance structures and reorganised them several times. Having established autonomous municipalities and regional administrative centres for a period, the movement dissolved these structures in 2023, shifting decision-making processes to a model based on smaller, local communities.




During this process, it developed its own mechanisms for education, healthcare, justice and community governance outside the official structures of the state, and prioritised the collective use of land and natural resources. We spoke with Professor Neil Harvey of New Mexico State University about the Zapatistas.




Who is Neil Harvey?




Dr Neil Harvey is Professor and Head of the Department of Government at New Mexico State University, specialising in Political Science, Public Law and Administration. Harvey, who studies social movements and struggles for democracy in Mexico and Latin America, has conducted field research in Chiapas. He is the author of The Chiapas Rebellion: The Struggle for Land and Democracy (Duke University Press, 1998) and has published numerous articles on the Zapatista movement and autonomy.




More than thirty years have passed since the 1994 Zapatista uprising. How would you describe the most significant transformation the movement has undergone in the process of moving from an armed uprising to the construction of autonomous political and social structures?




This transformation involved several important changes over time. First, there was a shift from armed uprising to a peaceful strategy based on effective communication, which gained broad support within Mexican society and internationally. Second, there was a transition from the highly centralised position of military commanders to a structure in which civilian Zapatista members in hundreds of local communities assumed stronger leadership. Finally, the language used by the movement changed. The more traditional revolutionary discourse of the Latin American left was replaced by an approach in which different goals and cultural elements, both specific to the Indigenous peoples of Chiapas and appealing to humanity as a whole in a broader sense, were continuously expressed.




Rather than seizing state power, the Zapatistas developed autonomous structures in areas such as local governance, education, healthcare and justice. Why did this path emerge, and what has enabled these structures to survive for so long?




Shortly after their uprising in 1994, the Zapatistas clearly stated that their aim was to "change the world without taking power". By this, they meant that they refused to engage in a struggle to seize state power in Mexico, preferring instead to create their own forms of self-government and autonomous decision-making mechanisms. This approach represents a different understanding of revolution, aimed at avoiding the pitfalls of centralised leadership, a single ideology and the associated pyramid-shaped organisational structure that can emerge when attempting to seize state power. It is a call to change the world by starting from the specific conditions of each place and period in which struggles for justice emerge, while doing so in alliance with one another.




The goal of autonomy initially emerged as an extremely urgent need in the rural Indigenous communities of Chiapas. In these areas, the presence of teachers, doctors and other services provided by central or local governments was very limited. In the 1970s and 1980s, while the EZLN was undergoing its own process of independent formation, community members were also working with the Catholic Church and some left-wing social movements to meet basic needs and improve living conditions. Given the persistent poverty and deaths from treatable diseases, these initiatives were of great importance. Over the past thirty years, the Zapatistas have built new structures upon these efforts by expanding education, healthcare and agroecology projects. At the same time, they rejected government programmes that they believed were tied to political conditions.




In 2023, the Zapatistas undertook a major restructuring of their autonomous structures, placing greater emphasis on Local Autonomous Governments (GAL). Why was this change necessary?




The transition to the more decentralised GAL structure emerged as a result of self-criticism of the model that had been in place for 20 years. The Zapatistas' regional Good Government Councils (Juntas de Buen Gobierno – JBG) were initially necessary for coordinating projects and collaborating with solidarity groups. However, over time, they became too centralised and were no longer sufficiently accountable to the local communities they were supposed to serve. Therefore, this change can be seen as an internal correction within the Zapatista model of autonomy. The aim is to give local communities a greater say and more participation in the decisions made by the movement.




The Zapatistas have also introduced the concepts of "the commons" and "non-ownership" in relation to some of the reclaimed lands. What do these mean in terms of autonomy, land and living together?




"The commons" and "non-ownership" are important in at least two interconnected ways. First, they offer a direct and practical way of reducing conflicts with non-Zapatista community members who, in the past, were mobilised by anti-Zapatismo political actors. Emphasising the shared use of some agricultural land by Zapatistas and non-Zapatistas helps build mutual trust, as the economic and social needs of these rural communities are largely similar, regardless of their political affiliations. Second, "the commons" and "non-ownership" are central to the Zapatistas' political goal of building relationships rather than fuelling divisions. The proposal to consider disputed lands as "ownerless" also challenges the widespread belief that the concept of property itself, whether in the form of private or state ownership, is closed to debate and to alternative understandings of our shared world.




In Turkey, discussions are taking place about ending the conflict between the Turkish state and the Kurdish movement, which has continued for more than forty years. Issues such as local democracy, women's participation, ecology and self-government are also important in Kurdish political thought. Without equating the two experiences, where do you think the meaningful common ground lies, and where should caution be exercised in making comparisons?




The Zapatistas' armed uprising defied even their own fears that the army would immediately suppress the rebellion. Although their methods did not receive the same level of support, their demands quickly gained support from broad sections of society. The armed conflict was relatively short-lived. After 12 days, both sides agreed to begin peace negotiations through a mediator accepted by both parties, the Catholic bishop of the region where the uprising took place. Compared with the conflict between the PKK and the Turkish army, this was a much shorter period. Furthermore, the Mexican government did not insist on the Zapatistas' disarmament, and disarmament has not become a major issue over the past thirty years. Throughout this period, the movement has continued to exist primarily through non-violent strategies, building autonomous healthcare, education and agroecology projects within its own communities.




The peace negotiations were also short-lived (1994–1996) and did not result in a lasting agreement. The agreements signed by the parties in 1996 concerning the recognition of Indigenous peoples' rights and cultures were not implemented by successive Mexican governments. As a result, the Zapatistas turned to putting their rights to autonomy into practice through their own methods. One of the government's arguments was that recognising the customs and traditions of Indigenous communities would threaten human rights law; another was that autonomous Indigenous governments would lead to the fragmentation and "Balkanisation" of the Mexican nation. Although none of these claims had any factual basis, they allowed the government to present itself as a defender of liberal tolerance and national unity. However, this was far removed from the understanding represented by the Zapatistas. The peace process in Turkey will need to avoid forms of exclusionary nationalism in order to enable the peaceful and democratic participation of all groups within a more inclusive country.




What is the most important lesson that more than thirty years of Zapatista autonomy offers to movements seeking to move beyond armed conflict while preserving their political identity and collective organisation?




The most important lesson is this: despite, or perhaps precisely because of, the counter-insurgency operations and paramilitary violence they have faced since 1994, the Zapatistas continue to embrace life and make it their priority. The movement remembers its past but looks towards the future. This can be seen both in the generational change among those involved in the movement and in its openness to art, theatre, music and dialogue. Their fundamental aims are based on building relationships and valuing them. The issue is not simply to achieve something for the Zapatistas, but to work towards ensuring that all humanity can live a dignified life in the future, at a time of global crises and wars.




The lesson offered by the Zapatistas is that we must stop the destruction of the conditions that make life possible in the future and refuse to accept the collapse these conditions are undergoing today. In this context, as part of the "Journey for Life" (La Gira por la Vida), the Zapatistas are planning for 1,111 people from their communities to travel from Chiapas to Mexico City in December 2026 to meet with and support families searching for their missing loved ones. This action can be seen as a stance that affirms the value of the lives of the missing and rejects the normalisation of the killing of thousands of people at the hands of criminal organisations, the militaristic policies that have been implemented since at least 2006 without success, as well as corruption among state officials and their collaboration with criminal organisations.




Armed conflicts leave behind deaths, trauma and collective memory. How have Zapatista communities related to those who lost their lives? What place does the memory of the dead hold in the movement's political and social life?




The most important point to emphasise here is that the Zapatistas embrace life and have always refused to create a cult around fallen heroes or martyrs. They have no interest in establishing museums about the armed period of the uprising or fuelling nostalgia. This period was extremely horrific: at least 145 people lost their lives, homes were destroyed and thousands of people were displaced by the Mexican army. Added to this were ongoing human rights violations caused by counter-insurgency operations and paramilitary groups, as well as events such as the massacre of 45 people by paramilitaries in the village of Acteal in 1997. The movement has always focused on celebrating life in all its beauty: the land, waters, youth, art, science, relationships with visitors from all over the world, and the joy of learning from one another on equal terms. This approach is also clearly expressed in the Zapatistas' "Declaration for Life", published in 2021. Nevertheless, those who lost their lives in the fighting in January 1994, or those who later died from illness, such as Comandanta Ramona, have not been forgotten. Their lives are remembered in murals, theatrical works and writings.




It is also important to remember that the uprising was carried out against forgetting. No one should have had to risk their life to gain access to clean water, housing, schools, health centres, freedom and peace. However, the Zapatistas felt they had to make this decision. During the decade before 1994, thousands of Indigenous people in Chiapas died from treatable diseases, and almost no one noticed. Faced with these preventable deaths, the Zapatistas chose life.




The Zapatista experience is often praised internationally. However, this experience also has its difficulties and contradictions. What do you think have been the main limitations of Zapatista autonomy?




One of the problems that emerged immediately after the uprising was that Subcomandante Marcos, who was non-Indigenous, of mestizo [a person of mixed European and Indigenous American ancestry] origin and educated in the city, became an overly central figure and almost the sole voice of the Zapatistas, despite his own efforts to explain that the movement was not about him. Much of the media focused heavily on Marcos, while saying very little about the movement's other Indigenous leaders and members. This created problems both in terms of how the movement was portrayed externally and highlighted the need to restructure its internal organisation by transferring decision-making authority from military commanders to the civilian support bases in the communities. This process was linked to the establishment of autonomous governance and became increasingly established after 2001. Another challenge was putting into practice the goal of ensuring broad participation by women and young people. Although positive steps were taken, this was not an easy process.




Source: 

Yeni Özgür Politika

title: Thousands commemorate 69 fallen guerrilla fighters in Kobanê
content:
Thousands of people from various cities across Rojava gathered in Kobanê to commemorate 69 members of the People’s Defense Forces (HPG) and the Free Women’s Troops (YJA Star) who lost their lives in the Kurdish freedom struggle over the years. Relatives of the fallen fighters, along with representatives of political parties and civil society organizations, attended the commemoration at the Şehîd Dicle Cemetery. The ceremony began with a minute of silence, followed by the reading of the names of the 69 guerrilla fighters.




Mustafa Êto, co-chair of the Council of War Veterans and Families of the Martyrs in Kobanê, paid tribute to the deceased fighters’ commitment to a democratic and just society.




“Our martyrs waged a historic struggle under all circumstances. Sixty-nine names also mean sixty-nine mothers. We will remain committed to their cause until the end,” he declared.










https://1649452211.rsc.cdn77.org/20261021141322_2026-10-21-kobane-hpg-yja-star-ozgurluk-gerillari-icin-duzenlenen-taziye-toreni-1.mp4













‘We will strengthen our resistance and organization’




Xerîb Hiso, co-chair of the Democratic Union Party (PYD), also commemorated the fallen fighters and their significance for the joint struggle of the peoples of Syria. He said they had stood against genocide, denial, and annihilation, dedicating their lives to freedom and democracy.




“We promise to further strengthen our struggle, our resistance, and the organization of our society. This is our promise to the martyrs,” Hiso said. He noted that Kurds, Arabs, and Turkmen were among those who had lost their lives. “These fallen fighters are a bridge between peace and resistance.”




Rûken Ehmed, a member of the coordination committee of the women’s movement Kongra Star in Kobanê, highlighted the significance of the decades-long guerrilla struggle for Kurdish society. She emphasized that preserving the gains achieved required defending the legacy of the martyrs.




Joint commemoration by different communities




Speaking on behalf of the Arab community, the father of fallen fighter Şahin Ereb said: “On behalf of the Arab community, I extend my condolences to you all. I am just as proud as you are. We are all united as one.”




Representatives of the Syrian Kurdish Democratic Party and the Council of Religions and Faith Communities of Kobanê also addressed the gathering.




Xalid Yûsif Xelef, speaking on behalf of the Cizîrê region, recalled Kobanê’s history of resistance.




“Today, we are in the city of Kobanê, which made history and declared: ‘We will never abandon this city.’ The 69 resistance fighters went to the free mountains and fell in a heroic struggle.”




At the conclusion of the ceremony, the commemorative certificates honoring the 69 fallen fighters were read aloud and presented to their families.

title: Prochaines initiations médic du collectif Soin Collectif Île-de-France
content:
Rendez-vous ce soir à 18h30 au cinéma la Clef salle 2 (34 rue Daubenton), et samedi matin au Baranoux (horaire à venir). Formation à prix libre d'environ 2h sur les bases du secourisme en manif, les armes de la police, et reconnaître les signes de gravité. Par 

Soin Collectif Idf




 

 

 

 




Au programme :




 Être médic


 Qui peut être médic

 Protéger, rassurer, respecter le consentement

 Les armes et les blessures


 Les armes de la répression

 Plaies, brûlures et traumas

 Quand c'est grave


 Reconnaître la gravité

 Obtenir l'intervention des secours




Ce soir à la Clef : 64 places disponibles, en sous-sol, non accessible 

PMR




Qui

 

?




Soin Collectif Île-de-France est un collectif de street-médics horizontal, indépendant et inclusif, basé à Paris et ses alentours.




Nous sommes avant tout des militant-e-s et participons dès lors à toute manifestation ou rassemblement qui correspondent à nos valeurs. Nous avons créé ce collectif afin de nous organiser entre personnes pratiquant la médic, de mettre en commun nos connaissances, et de faire connaître nos pratiques. Nous ne prétendons pas parler au nom de l'ensemble de nos membres ni diriger leurs actions.




Certain-es d'entre nous sommes professionnel-les ou volontaires du secteur de la santé et du secourisme, mais pas toustes : nos pratiques sont régulièrement différenciées de celles du soin institutionnel.




Nos valeurs




Nous nous revendiquons anarchistes, antifascistes, féministes, antiracistes, dévalidistees et révolutionanires. Nous ne sommes pas apolitiques : nous luttons aux côtés de celles et ceux qui se battent contre les réactionnaires et les oppressions, où qu'elles soient.




Nous nous positionnons contre les tendances virilistes que l'on peut trouver dans certains milieux médic (posture de mise en avant de soi, prise de risques inutiles, prise d'ascendant sur les autres).




Nos pratiques




Nous proposons notre aide à toute personne en ayant besoin, tout en prenant soin de préserver notre propre intégrité. Nous ne demandons pas de compensation, sous quelque forme que ce soit, y compris symbolique (nous nous opposons à l'héroïsation de la figure du médic).




Nous respectons le consentement des personnes prises en charge dans nos pratiques de soin. Nous avons pour volonté de lutter contre toute forme de discrimination, y compris et surtout dans nos propres milieux.




Nous sommes honnêtes vis-à-vis de nos compétences, nous nous efforçons de nous maintenir au niveau, d'apprendre, et d'approfondir les connaissances que nous avons afin d'apporter la meilleure aide à nos camarades.




Conscient-es de nos limites nous ne réalisons pas d'actes pour lesquels nous n'avons pas été formé-es afin de ne pas mettre en danger supplémentaire la personne secourue.




Nous contacter




Mail : medics-deter-idf [at] proton.me




On se soigne, on s'organise, on se défend

@sc.idf

author: Nehaa Bimal
title: ‘We want closure’: 1 year after Joshua Qiyuk’s death, family still seeking answers
content:
It’s been one year since Joshua Qiyuk was found stabbed to death in Ottawa, and his mother is still asking the same questions.




“I want to find out why, who did it,” Brenda Qiyuk said in an interview Monday, three days before the one-year-anniversary of her son’s death.




Joshua Qiyuk, a 21-year-old Inuk man from Baker Lake, was 

found dead

 on Oct. 22, 2025, in Ottawa’s Manor Park neighbourhood.




The city’s police service is still investigating his death. No arrests have been made, said police spokesperson Julie Kavanagh Tuesday in an email.




“We want closure,” Brenda said. “My son’s killer hasn’t been found yet. Where did this killer go? Why did they kill my son, and for what?”




She said investigators visited her in the spring so she could show them routes her son might have taken on his regular walks.




Joshua often walked to unwind after work, sometimes stopping at a nearby convenience store.
















On the night he died, Joshua finished work early and spent time at home with Brenda before she went to bed. She was unaware he had gone out for a walk.




Brenda said she later retraced the route herself in April, walking to the spot where his body was discovered, about 600 metres from their Vanier neighbourhood home.




The lack of answers has compounded an already difficult year for the family.




Joshua’s paternal grandfather died of a heart attack in May, followed by Brenda’s brother, both of whom had travelled south from Baker Lake last year to support Brenda.




Brenda said she receives monthly grief counselling and has reached out to elders in Baker Lake for support.




“Me and my family have been going through a really, really rough time emotionally,” she said. “We are trying to keep it together, but we’re also getting a lot of support from the right people.”
















Brenda hopes someone will come forward with information that could help investigators.




“My son’s life is gone and now we have to visit his gravesite,” she said. 




Joshua was buried in Winnipeg near his paternal grandmother, allowing family members to visit his gravesite more easily.




Joshua’s cousin, Alethea Noah, said the uncertainty has made grieving harder.




“The anger is a part of grief, but when it’s a situation like this, when somebody’s life was taken from them and we don’t know who [did it], and there’s no justice, it definitely heightens the anger,” Noah said.



















Noah helped connect Joshua and his older brother Curtis with youth programming at Ottawa’s Inuuqatigiit Centre for Inuit Children, Youth and Families when the family moved to Ottawa in 2019 from New Brunswick. 




“He was the kind of youth who never complained and was just a joy to have around for everybody,” she said.




Joshua went on to study culinary arts at Algonquin College after 

developing a passion

 for cooking. He worked at C’est Bon cooking school and Ottawa restaurant Absinthe, where he was proud of his first significant job in the industry, his mother said.




“We need to say his name because he deserves justice,” Noah said. “We can’t forget him and just let him go like that.”




Stefanie Siska, co-owner of C’est Bon Ottawa, said the business will donate 22 per cent of its sales on Oct. 22 to the Joshua Qiyuk Memorial Scholarship and Memorial Bursary at Algonquin College to support 

Indigenous culinary students.

title: Should AIPAC Register as a Foreign Agent? Zeteo Examines Pro-Israel Lobby's Influence on Elections
content:
The growing controversy over AIPAC’s impact on U.S. politics is the subject of a new Zeteo documentary titled 

Night Flower: Inside AIPAC’s Fight for Influence

. The film examines AIPAC’s history and its role in shaping U.S. policy toward Israel, and questions whether its activities warrant further scrutiny under the Foreign Agents Registration Act, or 

FARA

. “It says that you have to register under this law if you are acting at the request of a foreign government,” says Dion Nissenbaum, the filmmaker behind 

Night Flower: Inside AIPAC’s Fight for Influence

. “And we talked to numerous people who showed us several examples of how 

AIPAC

 is acting at the request of Israel.”




Referencing the title of the film, 

Night Flower

, Zeteo editor-in-chief Mehdi Hasan says 

AIPAC

 “blossoms in the dark, shrivels in the light. We’re trying to put some sunlight onto 

AIPAC

.”

author: anred
title: «Que no se apague la salud»: residentes y concurrentes realizan «Marcha de las Velas» contra el ajuste en los hospitales porteños
content:
Foto: archivo La Izquierda Diario




Bajo la consigna “La salud pública se defiende”, la Asamblea de Residentes y Concurrentes de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires (que nuclea a residentes y concurrentes de hospitales y centros de salud porteños) convocó para hoy, jueves 22 de octubre, a una nueva «Marcha de las Velas» en defensa de la salud pública, que partirá a las 18.30 desde el cruce de avenida Las Heras y Bulnes, en el Parque Las Heras, y finalizará a las 20 en Plaza Houssay. La convocatoria se realiza en el marco de la quinta semana de un plan de lucha por la recomposición salarial y contra el deterioro de las condiciones laborales. La Asamblea denuncia una pérdida del poder adquisitivo de 30 puntos desde 2023, jornadas laborales extensas, dificultades crecientes para sostener la atención sanitaria, y amenazas y hostigamientos contra quienes participan de las medidas de fuerza, que incluyen pedidos de listados de trabajadores adherentes y registros de asistencia que, según denunciaron, consignaron la palabra “Paro” incluso para residentes que estaban cubriendo guardias. 

Por ANRed.







La 

Asamblea de Residentes y Concurrentes de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires

 convocó para 

este jueves 22 de octubre a una nueva movilización en defensa de la salud pública

. La «

Marcha de las Velas

» partirá a las 

18.30 desde avenida Las Heras y Bulnes, en el Parque Las Heras, y finalizará a las 20 en Plaza Houssay

. La jornada se inscribe en la quinta semana de un plan de lucha por la recomposición salarial y contra el deterioro de las condiciones laborales.







El conflicto comenzó a mediados de septiembre. Desde entonces, se realizaron paros y movilizaciones semanales con participación de hospitales y centros de salud de la Ciudad. El 1 de octubre, residentes y concurrentes volvieron a parar durante 24 horas y marcharon hasta el Ministerio de Salud porteño, a cargo de 

Fernán González Bernaldo de Quirós

. En una jornada anterior, el paro había contado con la adhesión de 25 hospitales y efectores, según el relevamiento difundido por organizaciones del sector.




El reclamo central es una 

recomposición salarial del 30% para recuperar poder adquisitivo

, junto con 

adicionales por guardias y por especialidades críticas

, y 

un bono compensatorio retroactivo

. La Asamblea denuncia que los ingresos quedaron rezagados frente a la inflación.




Imagen: La Izquierda Diario




Las condiciones de trabajo también forman parte del conflicto: 

las y los residentes denuncian que pueden llegar a trabajar entre 70 y 90 horas semanales, con guardias de 24 horas e, incluso, extensiones de 36 horas.

 

Los concurrentes, por su parte, denuncian que realizan tareas sin percibir salario y sin contar con derechos laborales básicos como cobertura por accidentes de trabajo.

 La Asamblea plantea que estas condiciones afectan tanto a quienes sostienen las guardias y los servicios como a la calidad de la atención que recibe la población.




En la misma línea, a los reclamos salariales y por coindiciones laborales se suman las 

denuncias de hostigamiento y persecución por parte de las autoridades sanitarias porteñas

. Desde la Asamblea señalaron que en las últimas semanas 

recibieron avisos informales sobre posibles descuentos

, pedidos de

 listados con nombre y apellido de quienes participaron de las medidas de fuerza

 y 

registros de asistencia en los que figuraba “Paro” incluso para residentes que se encontraban cubriendo guardias

.




Foto: Maximiliano Luna / Télam.




La Asamblea también advierte sobre el 

vaciamiento del conjunto de la salud pública, las dificultades para acceder a medicamentos y turnos y la emergencia en salud mental

. También rechaza 

cualquier intento de fragmentar la carrera profesional regulada por la Ley 6.035 y plantea la necesidad de ampliar la organización colectiva a los trabajadores de planta

. En ese sentido, la propuesta de realizar asambleas hospitalarias conjuntas apunta a reunir demandas que atraviesan a distintos sectores del sistema sanitario.




Imagen: Bernardino Avila.




Antes de la Marcha de las Velas, 

una funcionaria del Comité de Docencia e Investigación (CODEI) recibirá a representantes del sector en una instancia de diálogo, según informó Prensa Obrera

. La Asamblea anticipó que llevará allí el reclamo de recomposición salarial y la necesidad de respuestas concretas. Mientras tanto, sostiene la convocatoria a la movilización y reclama que el Ministerio de Salud escuche sus demandas sin represalias contra quienes ejercen el derecho a huelga.

author: Amanda Audi
title: Homens praticam tiro contra imagem de Lula em clube de São Paulo
content:
Em um clube de tiro, uma dupla de homens armados pratica contra um alvo com o desenho do rosto do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). Entre risos, eles dizem “Faz o L” e “esse não vai participar da próxima eleição”. 

A câmera foca no rosto do boneco de Lula, mostrando furos de bala na parte superior da imagem. “Olha a carinha dele. Só na testa.” A legenda do vídeo é “toma essa picanha”.




No vídeo, os homens dizem:

– “Esse não vai participar da próxima eleição.”

– “Faz o L.”

– “Olha a carinha dele. Só na testa.”

Na legenda da publicação, escreveram: “Toma essa picanha”.




No vídeo, os homens dizem:

– “Esse não vai participar da próxima eleição.”

– “Faz o L.”

– “Olha a carinha dele. Só na testa.”

Na legenda da publicação, escreveram: “Toma essa picanha”.




O homem que postou o vídeo em seu perfil no WhatsApp foi identificado como Maurício Archangelo, dono de empresas na Zona Leste de São Paulo. Ao ser contatado, ele disse não se lembrar do vídeo. A reportagem explicou que ele estava, naquele momento, no dia 21 de outubro, publicado em seu status. Ele disse que ia ver e desligou. Neste intervalo, o vídeo foi apagado.




Em uma nova ligação, Archangelo disse que não sabia do que se tratava, desligou de novo e bloqueou o contato. A reportagem insistiu com outro número de telefone. Desta vez, Archangelo não respondeu às perguntas e se limitou à perguntar como foi feito o acesso ao seu status do WhatsApp.




No perfil do empresário no Instagram, que é aberto, há outra foto de Archangelo em um clube de tiro. 

Ele também já postou uma imagem de um bebê de poucos meses com uma arma na parte de trás da fralda. 




Bruno Langeani, consultor sênior do Instituto Sou da Paz, avalia que a conduta de atirar na foto de um presidente pode ser enquadrada como 

crime de ameaça

, que é prevista como “Ameaçar alguém, por palavra, escrito ou gesto, ou qualquer outro meio simbólico, de causar-lhe mal injusto e grave”. 




“Vindo de pessoas que têm acesso a arma de fogo e se tratando de políticos como Lula, que já tiveram a caravana em 2018 atingida por tiros e que na época da tentativa de golpe, em 2023, foi demonstrado que havia um plano para matá-lo também a tiros, isso é algo bastante grave e que deve ter providências sérias das autoridades”, afirma. Para ele, a investigação deve ser não só contra as pessoas que atiraram, mas também sobre o clube de tiro por permitir o uso dessas silhuetas em alvos de tiro”, complementa.




Em 2021, um vereador de Fortaleza foi 

condenado

 a pagar indenização por danos morais após atirar numa foto de Lula. No ano seguinte, quando o petista foi eleito para o seu terceiro mandato, o PT 

denunciou

 que clubes de tiro estariam usando a imagem do político em alvos e acionou a justiça.




Para o cientista político da Universidade Federal de São Paulo (Unifesp) o episódio da imagem de Lula ser usada como alvo por bolsonaristas é simbólico do processo de normalização da violência deste grupo. 

“Passa a ser normal tratar adversários como inimigos a quem se deve eliminar”, aponta.




Clube de tiro já foi alvo de ação policial no passado
















Publicação de Maurício Archangelo em rede social




A gravação ocorreu no Clube e Escola de Tiro 556, localizado na zona leste de São Paulo.

 O proprietário, Vinicius Monteiro Pires Inácio, afirmou estar viajando e desconhecer o episódio. Ele afirmou que os clientes “podem levar o alvo que quiserem”, desde que sejam caricaturas, e não fotos de pessoas reais. Também enfatizou que não incentiva e nem compactua com atos de incitação ao ódio.




Segundo ele, é comum que usuários do clube levem imagens como demônios ou o coringa, mas os funcionários não autorizam o uso de fotos de familiares e pessoas, famosas ou não.




Logo após ser procurado pela 

Agência Pública

, o clube de tiro fez um post no Instagram dizendo que é “expressamente proibida a impressão e utilização de imagens de pessoas reais como alvos em nossas instalações.” O post cita os artigos do Código Civil e do Código Penal que atribuem a conduta como criminosa. A empresa também diz que o descumprimento “poderá resultar em medidas administrativas e, conforme o caso, responsabilização civil e criminal”.




Inácio, que é influenciador ligado a pautas conservadoras conhecido como Magnata, afirma que a empresa exige que os usuários tenham as permissões regulares para utilizar o recinto, porém “não é possível observar o que os clientes fazem o tempo todo”. 




Em sua página pessoal, ele postou um vídeo na semana anterior ao 

primeiro turno

 mostrando pessoas com camisetas do Bolsonaro atirando, com a legenda “Domingo vai ser assim de novo”.

 O clube de tiro fez um evento para exibir a contagem de votos, com cerveja e petiscos.




O proprietário do clube afirma que é de direita, mas não compactua com o episódio. “A minha opinião política e partidária nunca teve sigilo. Tanto que eu perdi uma conta com mais de 800 mil seguidores no Instagram por expor o que eu penso. Mas uma coisa é o Vinícius, pessoa física. Outra coisa é o Magnata, proprietário do clube de tiro 556. Eu não deixo que opiniões políticas interfiram na minha empresa. Todo mundo é bem vindo lá”, disse.




Em 2023, o clube de tiro foi alvo de uma operação policial que apreendeu 38 armas.

 Segundo o 

SBT News

, o estabelecimento estaria fazendo rifas de armas de fogo com números vendidos a partir de R$ 1 o número, o que é proibido. Também, segundo a reportagem, deixava pessoas sem treinamento usar qualquer tipo de arma.




Segundo a 

portaria Nº 20.749

, de setembro de 2020, “armas e munições, explosivos, fogos de artifício ou de estampido” não poderão ser objeto de operação filantrópica, mediante distribuição de prêmios. A portaria também estabelece que “a distribuição de prêmios mediante sorteio, vale-brinde, concurso ou operação assemelhada realizada por organizações da sociedade civil, com o intuito de arrecadar recursos adicionais destinados à sua manutenção ou custeio, depende de prévia autorização do Ministério da Economia”.

title: Esad kardeşler için Interpol'e başvuru yapıldı
content:
Suriye’de eski Devlet Başkanı Beşar Esad ve kardeşi Mahir Esad hakkında Uluslararası Polis Teşkilatı'na (Interpol) başvuruda bulunuldu.

Suriye resmi haber ajansı SANA’nın Şam 4. Ağır Ceza Mahkemesi Başkanı Fahruddin el Aryan’a dayandırdığı habere göre, Esad kardeşler ile diğer mahkumlara ilişkin dosyalar Interpol’e gönderildi.

El Aryan, kardeşler hakkında verilen gıyabi kararların hukuki sonuç doğurduğunu belirterek, gerekli işlemlerin yürütülmesi amacıyla dosyaların Interpol’e iletildiğini söyledi.

Şam 4. Ağır Ceza Mahkemesi, ağustos ayında Beşar Esad ve Mahir Esad’ın da aralarında bulunduğu 7 kişi hakkında idam cezası kararı vermişti.

Interpol’e yapılan başvurunun, mahkeme kararlarının uluslararası düzeyde takibi amacıyla gerçekleştirildiği bildirildi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Mahmoud Bashir
title: Israeli forces arrest cancer patient, daughter returning to Gaza
content:
Israeli forces arrested two Palestinians on Tuesday evening as they were returning home to the Gaza Strip after traveling to Egypt for medical treatment, according to a statement from their family and one of their relatives who spoke to Mada Masr.




The two arrested, a cancer patient and her daughter, were among patients who were traveling both in and out of Gaza via the Rafah border crossing, which was reopened on Tuesday for the first time following its extended three-week closure by Occupation 

forces

.

 




Twenty-nine patients, along with 42 companions, 

left

 the Gaza Strip on Tuesday to receive treatment in Egyptian hospitals. Among them were critical cases, chronic disease patients and those with serious injuries. 

A group of 75 Palestinians returning to Gaza after receiving medical treatment abroad arrived via Rafah the same day to 

the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis.




The Rafah crossing, which was closed for almost two years after Israel 

occupied

 the crossing area in 2024, was 

reopened

 in February to provide passage to the sick and injured exiting Gaza for medical treatment, those returning from Egypt after completing treatment courses abroad, as well as for Palestinians who were 

stranded

 outside the strip and unable to return home amid Israel’s genocidal war.




Before they are allowed to return home, returnees must pass through extensive security checks administered by Israeli forces manning the Karam Abu Salem checkpoint. So far, a number of returnees have been subject to arrest at the site.




Amal Ghazy al-Rify and her daughter Yasmin Rifaat al-Rify were returning to Gaza on Tuesday after around two years of medical treatment in Egypt, according to 

Haitham al-Rify, a relative of the two women who lives in Gaza.

 Rify told Mada Masr that Amal is an elderly woman who was receiving treatment for her cancer, and that her daughter had traveled with her as a companion.




They decided to return without completing the medical course as Amal’s health and psychological condition had begun to deteriorate, he said, recalling that she had expressed her desire to return to Gaza despite her illness. “Before she set off on her way back, she said ‘I feel like I’m going to die, and I want to return to die in my country,” he recalled.




Describing Amal’s condition as critical, Rify said that she and her daughter had registered their data at the Palestinian Embassy in Cairo in order to return home, and that they had received prior approval for their travel. 




He condemned their arrest at the Karam Abu Salem checkpoint, stressing that neither is involved in any political or military activities. 




He told Mada Masr that the family was not informed by any entity about the circumstances of their arrest or their place of detention, adding that they have reached out to the International Committee of the Red Cross for further information but are yet to receive further details.




The family 

appealed

 in a statement on Wednesday to responsible parties, human rights and humanitarian organizations to intervene urgently to 

uncover the fate of Amal and Yasmine, to ensure their safety and work toward their release.

 




The two women left Gaza “seeking treatment and hoping for recovery and returned to find themselves facing detention instead of enjoying safety and stability after a tough medical trip,” according to the family’s statement, which added that medical “treatment is a right, dignity is a right and freedom is a right that cannot be infringed upon without a legal justification.”




The pair are not the first to be arrested during their return journey back. Before the extended closure of the crossing through October, Occupation forces arrested a young man named Mohamed Jihad al-Shourbajy at the border, prompting the Palestinian Center for the Defense of Prisoners to warn that the crossing was becoming a “trap” for Palestinians returning to their families. 




At the time, the center 

questioned

 the role of the European mission stationed at the crossing and its responsibility for ensuring the safety of citizens transiting through it.

 




Amal and Yasmin have not been allowed to contact their lawyers, the center stated on Thursday, expressing concern about their safety and conditions in custody. It added that their arrest brings the total number of Palestinians arrested at the crossing to seven, stressing that the border has come to represent a risk to travelers and again questioning the role of the European Union delegation at the facility.




The European mission has been in place in a technical capacity at the Rafah crossing since its February reopening. They suspended their work half-way through March in protest at another case of arrest. The mission described the March incident as a clear violation of the agreements signed by the parties regulating the crossing’s functioning and ensuring travelers’ freedom of movement.




When the crossing opened for two-way traffic in February, Palestinians returning to Gaza were subject to inspections at “Regevim,” a newly established Israeli-run checkpoint several kilometers inside the crossing in Palestinian Rafah. 




Palestinians subjected to these inspections 

described

 them to Mada Masr at the time as “humiliating and degrading,” explaining that they were blindfolded, restrained and interrogated for hours before being allowed to pass.




In July, the Occupation moved the checkpoint to Karam Abu Salem, in the strip’s southeast, continuing its inspections there. People returning to Gaza are required to navigate the Rafah crossing, travelling around 50 km east to the checkpoint, before they are finally allowed to enter the strip fully.




Israel’s Public Broadcasting Corporation, Kan, cited unnamed sources in July to claim that the move came after the discovery of attempts to smuggle unauthorized goods into the strip, including cigarettes, tobacco and electronic equipment. It claimed that the move would not hinder travelers’ movement and that the checkpoint’s relocation was to improve inspections and ensure the safe and efficient continuation of the crossing’s operation.




Regardless, the Occupation has repeatedly closed the crossing, as indicated in a 

report

 on border activity in September issued by the Gaza Crossings and Borders Authority.

 Severe disruptions  to movement were evident as the crossing was closed for 20 out of 30 days in the month. 




Zaher al-Wahidy, information unit manager at the Gaza Health Ministry, said around 30 to 40 patients are able to travel on days when the crossing is open; a tiny fraction of the 21,000 patients, of whom 5,600 are children, who have completed the necessary documents for medical transfer and are waiting inside the strip. 




Ten patients referred for treatment abroad died during the extended three-week closure as they were not able to travel, Wahidy said, adding that “every day of delay could cost the lives of more patients.”




He estimated that around 2,000 patients have died so far as a result of being prevented from traveling for treatment since Israel 

took control of the Rafah crossing 

in May 2024.




The Health Ministry in Gaza said last week that the crossing’s closure has led to a severe and rapid accumulation of critical medical cases, as waiting lists grow daily, exceeding the capacities of the exhausted and besieged hospitals’ ability to accommodate or provide the minimum standard of treatment. 




The ministry has 

called

 for serious and urgent pressure on Israel to open the strip’s crossings and facilitate the exit of patients in critical condition to save whoever can be saved.




Wahidy also emphasised that at least 200 patients should be allowed to travel every day, a step he said would help bring down the medical transfer waiting lists to which tens of people are added daily.




With hospitals and medical facilities decimated, and access to equipment and supplies 

limited

 by Israeli obstruction of the passage of goods into Gaza, options for treatment inside the strip are severely limited.




There is a “total absence of chemotherapy capacity,” Wahidy said, noting that equipment for surgeries is also limited since there is low capacity for diagnostic services through MRI scanning.




The Gaza Health Ministry 

warned

 on Thursday that limited access to engine oils is threatening hospital operations, which rely primarily on generators, currently at critical risk of “forced and sudden shutdown.”

The post 

Israeli forces arrest cancer patient, daughter returning to Gaza

 first appeared on 

Mada Masr

.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Mehdi Hasan on AIPAC's Role in El-Sayed vs. Rogers Race in Michigan & Trump's Targeting of Ilhan Omar
content:
One of the most closely watched races in the midterm elections is in Michigan between Democrat Abdul El-Sayed and Republican Mike Rogers. El-Sayed is a former public health official who is campaigning on a platform of Medicare for All, ending military aid to Israel, and getting corporate money out of politics. Rogers is a former Republican congressman backed by President Trump.




If elected, El-Sayed would become the first Muslim to serve in the U.S. Senate. During Wednesday’s debate in Michigan, Rogers repeated the claim, without providing evidence, that El-Sayed has ties to the Muslim Brotherhood. El-Sayed has repeatedly denied the accusation.




“If Abdul El-Sayed wins, it will be a reminder that the left can win in a swing state like Michigan,” says Mehdi Hasan, editor-in-chief of Zeteo. “And it will be actually a moment to say, 'You know what? Americans rejected Islamophobia.'”

title: Eski TFF Başkanvekili Lütfi Arıboğan hakkında "şike" davası
content:
Fotoğraf: Suece85/Wikimedia Commons CC BY-SA 4.0

Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı Terör Suçları Soruşturma Bürosunca yürütülen soruşturma kapsamında, eski Türkiye Futbol Federasyonu (TFF) Başkan Vekili Lütfi Arıboğan hakkında iddianame hazırlandı.

Türk Ceza Kanunu’nun (TCK) 220’nci maddesinin 7’nci fıkrası kapsamında düzenlenen iddianamede, Arıboğan’ın “silahlı terör örgütüne üye olmamakla birlikte örgüte bilerek ve isteyerek yardım etme” suçundan cezalandırılması talep edildi. İddianamenin düzenlenmesinin ardından Arıboğan hakkında 25. Ağır Ceza Mahkemesinde kamu davası açıldığı bildirildi.

Arıboğan, kamuoyunda ‘2011 futbolda şike soruşturması’ olarak anılan dönemin Fenerbahçe Başkanı Aziz Yıldırım’ı ve spor camiasına ilişkin operasyonlarla ilgili başlatılan soruşturma kapsamında, 25 Aralık 2025'te ifadeye çağrılmıştı.

Arıboğan, ifadeye çağrılan eski TFF genel sekreteri Ebru Köksal, Türkiye Milli Olimpiyat Komitesi Başkanı Ahmet Gülüm ve avukat İlhan Helvacı ile birlikte daha sonra serbest bırakılmıştı.

İstanbul Başsavcılığı dört kişinin "FETÖ" mensubu kamu görevlilerince usulsüz yürütülen soruşturma ve kovuşturmalarla ilgili Mehmet Baransu’yla irtibatlı olarak işlemlere iştirak ettikleri yönünde şüphe bulunduğunu belirtmişti.

Savcılık Arıboğan ve Helvacı’yı adli kontrol talebiyle hakimliğe sevk etmişti. Köksal ve Gülüm ise ifadelerinin ardından serbest bırakılmıştı.

Hakimlik Arıboğan ve Helvacı’nın yurt dışına çıkış yasağı ve karakola giderek imza verme şeklinde adli kontrol şartıyla serbest bırakılmasına karar vermişti.
